description_en: Queries a list of model groups
name: ListModelGroups

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AI gateway instance to which the resource belongs
parameters.help_zh: 资源所属的 AI 网关实例 ID
parameters.name: gateway_id

parameters.help_en: The keyword used to match model groups by name, description, member identity, or invocation name
parameters.help_zh: 按名称、说明、成员身份或调用名匹配
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. This parameter is required. Token-based pagination is used instead of pageNumber and pageSize
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token returned from the previous page. Omit this parameter for the first page. The value is empty or omitted for the last page
parameters.help_zh: 上一页返回的查询位置；首页省略，末页为空或省略
parameters.name: next_token

code.description_en: The response status code. The value is Ok for a successful request, or a specific business error code for a failed request
code.description_zh: 响应状态码。成功时返回 Ok，失败时返回具体业务错误码

data.description_en: The business result returned by the model group operation
data.description_zh: 模型组操作返回的业务结果

items.description_en: The list of model groups returned on the current page
items.description_zh: 本页查询返回的模型组列表

configurationDeployment.description_en: The summary of the most recent group configuration deployment returned by GetModelGroup. This is independent of the API release and entitlement status. If no task exists, this field is omitted and does not indicate success. The deployment represents the current version only when the revision matches the current version. This field is not guaranteed to be populated in list operations
configurationDeployment.description_zh: GetModelGroup返回的最近一次组选配置下发摘要，独立于API发布与许可状态；无任务时缺省，不代表成功。revision匹配当前version才表示当前版本；List不保证填充

operationId.description_en: The identity of the group configuration task, which is used for tracking only. This task cannot be accessed by GetLogicalModelDeployment or RetryLogicalModelDeployment
operationId.description_zh: 组配置任务身份，只供跟踪；不能由GetLogicalModelDeployment或RetryLogicalModelDeployment访问
operationId.title_en: 组配置任务身份，只供跟踪；不能由GetLogicalModelDeployment或RetryLogicalModelDeployment访问。
operationId.title_zh: 组配置任务身份，只供跟踪；不能由GetLogicalModelDeployment或RetryLogicalModelDeployment访问。

revision.description_en: The group version corresponding to this task, which may be earlier than the current group version
revision.description_zh: 该任务对应的组版本；可能早于当前组version
revision.title_en: 该任务对应的组版本；可能早于当前组version。
revision.title_zh: 该任务对应的组版本；可能早于当前组version。

status.description_en: The status of the deployment. Valid values: Pending, Running, Succeeded, Failed, and PartiallyFailed

configurationDeployment.title_en: GetModelGroup返回的最近一次组选配置下发摘要，独立于API发布与许可状态；无任务时缺省，不代表成功。revision匹配当前version才表示当前版本；List不保证填充。
configurationDeployment.title_zh: GetModelGroup返回的最近一次组选配置下发摘要，独立于API发布与许可状态；无任务时缺省，不代表成功。revision匹配当前version才表示当前版本；List不保证填充。

description.description_en: The description of the model group
description.example: 用于业务接入的模型组。

entitlementState.description_en: The control plane delivery status and revision number of the model access entitlement
entitlementState.description_zh: 模型访问许可的控制面下发状态及修订号

desiredRevision.description_en: The desired entitlement revision number to be delivered
desiredRevision.description_zh: 需要下发的期望授权修订号

errorMessage.description_en: The error message when processing fails. This field is empty if no errors occur
errorMessage.description_zh: 处理失败时的错误说明；没有错误时为空

status.description_en: The status of the entitlement. Valid values: Pending, Applying, Committed, and Failed. Committed indicates that the control plane has submitted and read back the configuration, but does not guarantee acknowledgment from all pods
status.description_zh: Pending、Applying、Committed或Failed；Committed仅指控制面提交并回读，不保证全部Pod ACK
status.title_en: Pending、Applying、Committed或Failed；Committed仅指控制面提交并回读，不保证全部Pod ACK。
status.title_zh: Pending、Applying、Committed或Failed；Committed仅指控制面提交并回读，不保证全部Pod ACK。

gatewayId.description_en: The ID of the AI gateway instance to which the resource belongs
gatewayId.description_zh: 资源所属的 AI 网关实例 ID

modelCardIds.description_en: The collection of model card identifiers

modelGroupId.description_en: The model group ID. Use the modelGroupId returned by CreateModelGroup
modelGroupId.description_zh: 模型组 ID，使用 CreateModelGroup 返回的 modelGroupId

name.description_en: The name of the model group

updateTime.description_en: The update time in RFC3339 format

nextToken.description_en: The pagination token returned from the previous page. Do not specify this parameter when you query the first page
nextToken.description_zh: 上一页返回的分页标识；查询首页时不传入

totalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the current query conditions
